    <h2 style="margin-top:0">Hi, I'm Bill</h2>
    <p>My name is Duc Le, and most people call me Bill. I'm in my last year of an MS in Supply Chain Management at the University of Houston's Bauer College of Business, and I work in procurement at Oliden Technology in Stafford, which builds MWD/LWD and rotary steerable tools.</p>
    <p>Most of my work is the part nobody sees: finding shops that can machine a part to print, keeping orders in step with drawing changes, and checking that what arrives is what we asked for. I like that the job sits between engineering, finance, and the supplier, and that a late part means a late tool.</p>
    <p>At school I'm learning to back that work with data. This site collects what I've built, mostly in R.</p>
